body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0006 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "GitHub: Actions workflow modified - Detects modifications to GitHub Actions workflows which can be used to execute malicious code in CI/CD (supply chain risk)."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0006"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1195"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "workflows.workflow_file_modified" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.actions_workflow_update" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.create_workflow" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.update_workflow" nocase)
    $action = $e.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $action over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $actors = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $repos = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)

  condition:
    $e
}
